title.narrative: HPN - Cluster 1:Stawisha Pwani- FP/RMNCAH & Nutrition (Kwale County)

description.narrative: (Kenya): USAID will support the Stawisha Pwani to increase the use of quality county-led health services in Kwale County through a service delivery systems approach. The integrated activity leverages PEPFAR funds to support a systems strengthening approach to address maternal, adolescent, newborn, child health and nutrition sustainably; its focus will be on advancing sustainable development by unlocking the potential of healthy and productive populations to drive inclusive and sustainable development. The activity will utilize innovative context-specific strategies to increase the knowledge of and demand for essential services and multi-sectoral approaches to achieve results within an integrated activity. USAID investments will strengthen health systems and build local capacity for RMNCAH and nutrition. The activity will strengthen Kenyan systems by:.Building the capacity of county and sub-county health managers on leadership, management, accountability and governance. Creating awareness within counties on domestic resource mobilization approaches and ring fencing of health budgets, so as to increase and secure health related budgets.Improving access to antenatal care and skilled birth attendance through advancing universal health coverage by increasing the number of health facilities enrolled in Linda Mama/Free Maternity Services rolled out by the National Health Insurance Fund among rural populations.Improving health information systems to provide quality and timely data in District Health Information Software 2.Supporting counties in building strong integrated commodity supply systems at the facility, sub- county and county levels.Ultimately, the mechanism will enable counties to expand access to and use of voluntary family planning; antenatal care; emergency obstetric and newborn care; postnatal care for mothers and babies; immunization; child and maternal nutrition services. $200,000 of the $1,000,000 will be used to meet the "micronutrients" earmark
